summary: Practise DHIS2 service checks, PostgreSQL backup review, and incident diagnosis. Explore the five-day foundation course.
lede: DHIS2 server administration covers the host, application, and database checks needed to keep a deployment supportable. Designed for system administrators, health information officers, and technical support staff, the course develops practical skills in checking Linux hosts, interpreting PostgreSQL and service logs, documenting configuration changes, and preparing backup-and-restore plans.
audienceIntro: This course suits technical staff responsible for keeping DHIS2 deployments accessible, supportable, and recoverable. It also fits adjacent health information roles that coordinate application operations with reporting teams.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with computer systems and routine IT support is helpful. No programming is required; exercises use administration concepts and configuration examples rather than Java development.
